title: NYC’s Biggest Food & Wine Festival Returns This Fall
description: New York City’s most anticipated foodie weekend is back this October 15-18th! The Food Network New York City Wine & Food Festival presented by Invesco QQQ (NYCWFF) returns for its 19th year bringing its signature blend of acclaimed chefs, NYC’s best restaurants, celebrities, innovative spirits, and city-wide flavor to over 50 food and wine events....
